message.content: {"note_claim": "The Amazing Spider-Man films with Andrew Garfield were Sony productions, while Tom Holland's Spider-Man films are a separate MCU franchise.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "las películas The Amazing Spider-Man de Marc Webb (2012 y 2014) protagonizada por Andrew Garfield [...] En febrero de 2015, Disney, Marvel Studios y Sony hicieron un trato para introducir una nueva versión de Spider-Man que se introdujo e integró en el Universo cinematográfico de Marvel", "reason": "The page clearly distinguishes the Garfield-led Sony Amazing Spider-Man films from the Holland-led MCU Spider-Man films introduced via a 2015 Disney/Marvel/Sony deal, directly supporting the note's claim of separate franchises."}
